Lead Data Scientist · Applied AI | GenAI & LLM Systems · Multi-Agent RAG · Fine-Tuning · ML Evaluation
Bengaluru, India  |  gauravgandhi429@gmail.com  |  +91-8789321250  |  LinkedIn  |  GitHub  |  Portfolio

I build AI systems and see them through — from first experiment to production. Five years across enterprise GenAI and ML: I currently lead and mentor a 5-person data-science team in Uber's AI org (via Indium), shipping document intelligence, multi-agent RAG copilots, and LLM fine-tuning pipelines — including a document-understanding transformer pretrained on 50M+ documents that displaced manual review for $10M+ in annual savings. Outside work I build and publish independent AI systems, with a research focus on agent tool-use quality. I care most about honest evaluation: every number I ship is measured, and I say so when a simple baseline wins.

text_runs.text: Warmer — daily semantic word game

— built the full product (Flutter, sentence-transformers, Firebase), running live daily. Diagnosed Hinglish embeddings scoring near-random as a script-mismatch bug, then trained and published the LoRA fine-tune that now serves production (hinglish-relatedness-sbert on Hugging Face): Spearman −0.003 → 0.813, held-out 0.435 → 0.704.

Style Maitri — AI stylist for Indian occasion wear — Achieved 93.8% intent-parsing accuracy (n=211) and NDCG@10 of 0.918 over a 52,000-item catalogue from 8 stores by building a LangGraph agent on hybrid retrieval (FAISS + BM25 with cross-encoder reranking) and a grounding layer that removes invented price, size, and fabric claims.

TriageIQ — ML issue-triage service (GCP Cloud Run) — Reached 87 to 90% top-3 accuracy in routing GitHub issues to the right component by combining a temperature-calibrated classifier, semantic retrieval of similar solved issues (BGE + FAISS), and conformal prediction intervals for resolution time; LLM fabrication rate is enforced as a hard CI gate.
DealHunter — multi-agent flight search

— natural-language trip requests to Pareto-ranked itineraries via SSE streaming — planner/optimizer agents with an LLM-as-judge eval harness, hardened by a deterministic replay suite with per-run cost accounting.
